gen-zen-dots-gf-tenor-sans: Techy, friendly, lots of space. Zen Dots barely thins its strokes at all, whereas plain sans Tenor Sans shows a moderate, visible thinning that gives the pair its gentle push and pull.
gen-zen-dots-gf-tirra: Zen Dots leaves a generous patch of room around every letter, and the openings stay wide at every weight. But Tirra, whose round forms read like open parentheses, wants a size a notch larger.
gen-zen-dots-gf-titillium-web: Zen Dots gives each letter generous room, friendly and techy, with openings that hold up at every weight. Titillium Web keeps its stroke ends set far apart, and that shared openness is what ties the pair together.
gen-zen-dots-gf-tomorrow: Spacious and cheerful: Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room, while the bowls in Tomorrow open like cupped clay palms. That shared generosity is what makes the pair work.
gen-zen-dots-gf-trispace: Zen Dots wraps every letter in generous room, friendly and techy at any weight. Trispace, a plain sans with sparse, widely set letters and curves that open outward, carries the same spaciousness down into the text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Tsukimi Rounded is a plain sans of pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, with round forms like open parentheses. And text in it should glide along smoothly under Zen Dots, whose own strokes barely vary either.
gen-zen-dots-gf-tuffy: Friendly, first of all, thanks to Zen Dots and its spacious letters. Tuffy, a sans-serif sketched as if with a pencil that never presses harder, would read smoothly and steadily across many lines of text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-urbanist: Urbanist moves like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut, leaving a single-width trail like a rolling-ball pen. So a page of this sans-serif should feel smooth under the gaze, a quiet counterpart to Zen Dots.
gen-zen-dots-gf-varela: Round, open and cheerful: Zen Dots gives every letter generous room at any weight. And Varela, with a t whose crossbar and stem share one width, extends that thread-like simplicity into the text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-varela-round: Varela Round is a plain sans that moves smoothly, its counters framed by same-width strokes and no hairlines or shadows. Zen Dots matches that stroke-for-stroke simplicity while giving its own letters generous room up in the heading.
